param_input_item.param_description: Wolfram rule number, an integer in [0, 255].
Number of rows (time steps) to compute.
Optional first row (length width); default is a single centered cell.

param_output_item.param_description: A generations-by-width 0/1 matrix, one row per time step.

description.p: Run a Wolfram elementary (one-dimensional, two-state, nearest-neighbor) cellular automaton and stack its successive rows into an image. Rule 30 is chaotic, rule 90 draws the Sierpinski triangle, rule 110 is Turing-complete.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: A = tessera.automaton1d(30, 201, 100); imagesc(A); axis image off; colormap(gray(2))
